accepted_claims: Over C, graph curves of bidegrees (1,a),(b,1), with positive a,b and ab>1, have total tangency excess sum_p(I_p-1) <= 2a+2b-4.
The number of distinct intersections is at least (a-2)(b-2)+1; the number with I_p>=q>=2 is at most floor((2a+2b-4)/(q-1)).
The pair proposed in Orevkov section 1.3, with n distinct contacts of multiplicity n, cannot exist for n>=5, with no symmetry assumption.
The obstruction excludes this graph-pair construction route precisely in the n>=5 range where its proposed plane-curve family would have proper-point h<-2.
not_claimed: A solution of the existence problem for reduced irreducible complex plane curves with proper-point h<-2.
Nonexistence of every degree-26 curve with 30 ordinary quintuple points, or a converse reducing every such curve to the graph construction.
Impossibility of the asymmetric n=4 graph pair or realization/elimination of the earlier degree-21 necessary patterns.
An independent proof of the full imported Epstein dynamical theorem or full Orevkov plane construction.
Global novelty, priority, exhaustive literature clearance, external human peer review, journal acceptance or proof-assistant certification.
scope_fields.standard_dependency: Epstein, arXiv:math/9902158v1, Theorem 1; its parabolic multiplier-one consequence is explicitly stated and applied.
scope_fields.publication_edition: Authored proof-only; complete graph obstruction proof and substantive independent audit.
